audit_events_target.name: audit_events_target
audit_events_target.value: "audit_events"."target_type" GLOB '[a-z]*' AND length("audit_events"."target_type") <= 32 AND length("audit_events"."target_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

collection_windows_end.name: collection_windows_end
collection_windows_end.value: ("collection_windows"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "collection_windows"."end_reason" IS NULL) OR ("collection_windows"."ended_at" >= "collection_windows"."started_at" AND "collection_windows"."end_reason" IN ('professor', 'consent_changed', 'policy_changed', 'unknown_participant', 'member_left', 'bot_removed', 'slack_revoked', 'course_ended'))
